signals.text: Revenue grew 10% a year over 3 years vs 9% over 5: growth is steady.
Profit compounded at 13% vs revenue at 10%: operating leverage is showing.
Operating margin expanded 195 bps in 3 years (43.4% → 45.3%).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 94% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

delivered.statement: Revenue increased by 12% to 76.7 billion rupees in fiscal year 2025-26.
Net income grew by 11% to 26.4 billion rupees in fiscal year 2025-26.
Sustained a healthy net margin of 34% in fiscal year 2025-26.
Operating margin remained at an industry-leading 44% in fiscal year 2025-26.
Declared two interim dividends totaling 400 rupees per equity share for fiscal year 2025-26.
R&D spend for 2025-26 was about 10% of total revenue.

calls.tone: confident on AI transformation and long-term growth, declining to provide short-term forward guidance.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned whether AI simplifying complexity could make OFSS products less important.
Concern raised regarding 51% of revenue coming from a single customer (Oracle).
Query on news items suggesting Oracle is selling a part of OFSS.
